topics.name: Gas Power Cycles

questions.prompt: What does the Second Law of Thermodynamics state regarding an isolated system?
options: The total entropy of an isolated system always increases or remains constant for reversible processes
Temperature cannot drop below zero Celsius
Heat naturally flows from colder to hotter bodies
questions.explanation: The second law establishes the arrow of time: Delta S_isolated >= 0 for any natural process.

questions.prompt: What represents the thermal efficiency of a reversible Carnot heat engine operating between temperatures T_H and T_L (in Kelvin)?
questions.explanation: The maximum theoretical efficiency of any heat engine operating between two thermal reservoirs is eta = 1 - (T_L / T_H).
